<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 12"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Chorus Companion](/Feats.aspx?ID=5420) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Bard" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=546" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 65

**Prerequisites**
[zoophonia muse](/Muses.aspx?ID=9), mature animal companion

</column>

---

Animals can be musical partners as much as the subjects or audience. Your animal companion becomes trained in [Performance](/Skills.aspx?ID=45) (or expert if it was already trained). When you cast a [composition](/Traits.aspx?ID=559) spell, you can have it originate either from you or from your animal companion, if your animal companion is within 30 feet of you.
name: Chorus Companion
